name: Aquarius Dwarf
tagline: DDO 210 — one of the Local Group's most metal-poor members, a nearly dark gas cloud with sparse stars.
history: The Aquarius dwarf (DDO 210) is an extremely faint irregular — among the most metal-poor galaxies in the Local Group, a thin scattering of young and old stars suspended in a dark halo it barely lights. Its sparsity makes it a useful lower bound on the galaxy luminosity function, and its isolation means its history is written by internal processes rather than the stripping and shocking that shape satellites.
